title: Intrinsically disordered regions influence protein motif usage in Drosophila Ubx and AbdA Hox proteins
authors: Corinne Maurel-Zaffran; Ilan Edelstein; Laurianne Michel; Meiggie Macchi; Nathalie Caruso; Andrew J Saurin; Yaakov Levy; Yacine Graba
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过粗粒化分子动力学模拟，揭示无序区域通过动态分子内相互作用调控Hox蛋白中保守基序的利用，虽对象为转录因子而非典型PPI，但为IDR介导的互作机制建模提供了可迁移思路。
abstract: Hox proteins are evolutionary conserved transcription factors guiding morphogenesis in all bilaterian animals. Conservation mainly concerns the homeodomain (HD), a helix-turn-helix DNA binding motif and flanking sequences close by. Besides, sequences are poorly conserved and disordered. Here we investigate how poorly conserved Intrinsically Disordered Regions (IDRs) influence Hox protein activity, focusing on a closely related Drosophila Hox pair and using a wide range of in vivo function. Studying Drosophila Ultrabithorax (Ubx) and AbdominalA (AbdA) proteins, we find that conserved protein motifs close to the HD are differently used in Ubx and AbdA. Coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations identify a large set of intra-molecular interactions, notably involving poorly conserved disordered regions upstream and downstream the HD. Swapping these regions in Ubx and AbdA alters protein functions and switches motif dependency in some biological situations. This suggests that IDRs, predicted to mediate large and dynamic sets of intramolecular interactions, influence protein motif usage in a context dependent manner.
abstract_zh: Hox蛋白是进化上保守的转录因子，指导所有两侧对称动物的形态发生。保守性主要涉及同源结构域（HD），即螺旋-转角-螺旋DNA结合基序及其邻近的侧翼序列。此外，序列保守性差且呈无序状态。在此，我们研究保守性差的固有无序区域（IDRs）如何影响Hox蛋白活性，聚焦于密切相关的果蝇Hox配对，并利用广泛的体内功能分析。通过研究果蝇Ultrabithorax（Ubx）和AbdominalA（AbdA）蛋白，我们发现靠近HD的保守蛋白基序在Ubx和AbdA中被差异使用。粗粒化分子动力学模拟识别出大量分子内相互作用，特别是涉及HD上游和下游保守性差的无序区域。在Ubx和AbdA中交换这些区域会改变蛋白功能，并在某些生物学情境中切换基序依赖性。这表明，预测介导大量动态分子内相互作用的IDRs，以情境依赖方式影响蛋白基序的使用。
